brief:
**BLUF:** In the core, a Mercer County WV school crossing guard was injured this morning when struck by a car at Glenwood School, with no charges filed yet. Tazewell County’s new consolidated volunteer fire company became operational on Oct. 15, supported by a meals tax and plans for a paid part-time department in spring 2027. In the region, a Mercer County man pleaded guilty in a federal drug case.[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/22/school-crossing-guard-injured-when-hit-by-car-glenwood-school/)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
**Core**  
- Mercer County, WV: A Mercer County Schools crossing guard directing traffic at Glenwood School was struck by a car that went around another vehicle; the guard fell, hit his head, and was transported to the hospital with apparent non-life-threatening injuries. Mercer County Sheriff’s Department Chief Deputy Maj. J.J. Ruble reported no charges filed as of the morning of Oct. 22. Identity and condition not released. [OSINT - NEWS][[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/22/school-crossing-guard-injured-when-hit-by-car-glenwood-school/)  
- Mercer County, WV: A Mercer County man pleaded guilty in a federal drug case (reported Oct. 22). [OSINT - NEWS]  

Nothing else reported in the last 24 hours for Tazewell County Sheriff’s Office, Virginia State Police Division IV, local police departments, or Southwest Virginia Regional Jail.

## FIRE, EMS AND RESCUE
**Core**  
- Tazewell County, VA: The Tazewell County Volunteer Fire Co. (merger of 11 former departments into stations under three battalions) became operational Oct. 15 to address recruitment, funding, and training issues. Funded in part by a new 4.7% meals tax generating ~$750,000 annually; applications for a paid part-time three-person 24/7 engine expected soon, with operations targeted for spring. [OSINT - NEWS][[2]](https://cardinalnews.org/2026/10/22/sjn-tazewell-county-restructuring/)  

Nothing else reported in the last 24 hours.

## HAZARDS, WEATHER AND ROADS
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours. No active NWS alerts.

## GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS
**Core**  
- Bluefield, VA (Tazewell County): Bluefield Industrial Development Authority purchased the former Graham Jewelry building on Virginia Avenue and began exterior renovation work. Secured $545,000 in grants ($245k from Virginia DHCD Industrial Revitalization Fund, $250k from Tobacco Region Revitalization Commission, $50k from Virginia Economic Development Partnership for abatement). Final plans pending. [OSINT - NEWS][[3]](https://woay.com/renovation-project-underway-on-former-graham-jewelry-building-in-downtown-bluefield/)  

Nothing else reported in the last 24 hours.

## ECONOMY AND OTHER
**Core**  
- Tazewell County, VA: Tazewell County Veterans Assistance Commission expanding staff and services for more than 7,000 local veterans (reported Oct. 22). [OSINT - NEWS]  

Nothing else reported in the last 24 hours.
